title: Quasi-isomorphism of the specified product diagonal augmentation
statement: Let A be a commutative condensed ring, G,H profinite groups, and B any additive bicosimplicial inhomogeneous product bar with the represented sections, all face and degeneracy formulas and constant-function augmentation specified in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] and the product action setting [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]. Let V be the normalized invariants functor for G times H. For any N and any nonnegative equivariant injective resolution N[0]→I of [def-sp-injective-resolutions], there exists a chain map j:V(I)→Tot_diag B(I) such that j^q is V.inclusion at I^q followed by B.augmentation at I^q followed by the actual degree-zero total coprojection. This very j is a quasi-isomorphism. The total is the finite first-quadrant signed total of [def-sp-double-complex-total]. The assertion includes arbitrary resolutions of zero and either group trivial.

proof.text: Reorder the profinite tuples in diagonal degree n as (G times H)^n. The first face is the product of (g,1) and (1,h), hence the (g,h) action; interior and final faces multiply and delete paired coordinates and degeneracies insert (1,1). The represented free and internal Hom adjunctions identify this full diagonal with the single product-group bar. The constant-function augmentation is unchanged.

proof.text: Choose the homogeneous free bar resolution and apply [lem-sfb-condensed-injective-bar-rows] at every injective I^q, with group G times H. It identifies the normalized augmentation with the invariant inclusion. Its internal augmented exactness implies that its map from the complex supported in degree zero is a quasi-isomorphism: the degree-zero kernel is exactly invariants, and all positive cohomology vanishes.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent-formulated internal-bar expansion: product-resolution-model step 6, actual degree-zero invariant inclusion and its diagonal-total quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-condensed-action-injective-restriction], forgetting is exact and preserves injectives. The normalized invariant functor is right adjoint to exact inflation in [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation], hence left exact. Resolution maps commute with the invariant inclusion and all bar operators. The invariant augmentation supported in group degree zero is a chain map with the displayed components, since the horizontal differential kills invariant sections and the vertical sign there is +1. Apply [lem-sfb-condensed-bar-total-augmentation] to the augmented rows in the previous step. This gives the quasi-isomorphism of the actual chain map, and coordinate transport gives the stated j. All sums in any total degree are finite.

theorem exists_productBarAugmentation (B : ProductBar A.toMon G H)
    (V : Invariants A (G × H)) {N : Equivariant A (G × H)} (I : InjectiveResolution N) :
    ∃ j : (V.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶
        B.diagonalTotal I.cocomplex,
      (∀ q : ℕ, j.f q =
        V.inclusion.app (I.cocomplex.X q) ≫ B.augmentation.app (I.cocomplex.X q) ≫
          B.diagonalZero I.cocomplex q) ∧ QuasiIso j
